title: Advanced Wound Management Outcomes Registry
official: Smith & Nephew Advanced Wound Management Outcomes Registry (AWMOR)
summary: This registry is designed to collect information on how Smith+Nephew Advanced Wound Management products are used in routine clinical practice. Information will be collected about participants treated with eligible Smith+Nephew products as part of routine wound care and entered into a registry database. The data collected will be used to improve understanding of how these products are used across different patients and clinical settings.

interventions.name: Marketed Smith+Nephew Advanced Wound Management product

criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* The following consent requirements are met:
* The subject and/or the subject's legally authorized representative has provided written informed consent and/or assent, as applicable, prior to any registry data collection; or
* For subjects contributing retrospective data only, a waiver or exemption of informed consent has been approved by the applicable ethics committee/institutional review board and is permitted by local laws and regulations.
* The subject is receiving or has received routine clinical care at a participating site for the management of one or more wounds.\*
* Treatment has been initiated with at least one in-scope Smith+Nephew Advanced Wound Management product\* as part of routine clinical care for an eligible wound, based on the treating clinician's judgment, within 180 days prior to or on the date the subject is identified as potentially eligible for registry participation.
* Where one or more wounds are included, the wound(s) selected for inclusion must be, in the opinion of the Investigator, clearly distinguishable as separate wounds and not merging with adjacent wounds.

\[\*\] Subjects may contribute data for multiple wounds and/or multiple products, where applicable.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Concurrent participation in an interventional clinical trial that, in the opinion of the Investigator, could reasonably confound interpretation of wound outcomes or product use.
* The subject has received a Smith+Nephew Advanced Wound Management product within scope of the registry solely for an internal surgical application, including but not limited to anastomotic, nerve repair/wrap, tendon repair, ligament repair, or other internal tissue repair procedure.
* The subject has received a Smith+Nephew Advanced Wound Management product within scope of the registry solely for the purpose of wound prevention (e.g., pressure injury prevention).
